# Containment of SCP-106
By default, SCP-106 spawns in its containment chamber, which restricts its movement and prevents it from leaving. The containment chamber is a safety measure that makes containing the entity safe.
[textlink="General information about the Old Man" link="Scp106About"]
[textlink="More information about escaping as the Old Man" link="Scp106ContainmentBreach"]
## What Should You Do?
The entity's main way to cause a containment breach is to use the "Become a Phantom" ability. It allows the Old Man to assume a phantom form that can pass through any obstacle.
[textlink="More information about abilities" link="Scp106Abilities"]
To escape, the phantom must find a corpse and use the "Reversion" ability on it. This sends the corpse to SCP-106's dimension and places the Old Man where it was.
The personnel's task is to stop the phantom from taking a corpse. This requires tracking SCP-106's location and checking people's condition on the personnel monitoring console.
## What Should You Do If the Entity Escapes?
The Foundation has developed an advanced piece of technology called the "Locus Vest", which prevents the Old Man from teleporting a victim to the pocket dimension.
The entity is completely immune to damage, but you can still slow it briefly with a taser.
To return the Old Man to his containment chamber, drag a D-Class employee into a special compartment called the "bone breaker". You will recognize this room by its unusually small size and single blast door. Once the D-Class enters the bone breaker, they will be disemboweled, and SCP-106 will immediately teleport back to its containment chamber.
